summary.en-US: Zero-knowledge encrypted vault for notes, tasks, habits and expenses

description.en-US:
Zero-Trust. Zero-Knowledge. 100% Private.

Vault Tracker is a decentralized productivity suite for people who refuse to compromise on privacy. Built with a security-first philosophy, it keeps your notes, tasks, habits and expenses in vaults sealed with military-grade encryption — on your device only.

* No backend: your data never touches a server
* No account, no sign-up, no tracking, no analytics
* Your master password derives the encryption keys locally (PBKDF2); every item is sealed with AES-256-GCM before it reaches storage
* Since v1.2.0 the vault database is SQLite with SQLCipher — the whole database file is encrypted under a device key held in your phone's Keystore, and existing installs migrate automatically
* Sovereign Sync (optional) backs up only encrypted blobs to your own cloud — WebDAV, S3 or Google Drive
* Hands-free voice-to-vault commands, processed locally

Your identity is your master password. We never hold your keys or your data — by architecture, not by promise.
